scope: Genuine NSFL/gore classifier candidate qualification; not integrated or accepted

candidate.declared_license: Model card declares MIT; base SwiftFormer configuration declares Apache-2.0. Attribution/license packaging must be preserved before bundling.
candidate.limitations: Author explicitly describes NSFL as underrepresented in training data. Reported aggregate accuracy is not HiChat acceptance evidence. Dataset is proprietary; no training/evaluation images were downloaded.

verification.detail: Installed eighteen packages into a newly created temporary directory, not the application. Existing client package.json/lock were not modified by the probe.

verification.command: Real pinned ONNX inference with ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0, WASM, numThreads=1
verification.detail: Input image: float32 [batch,3,224,224]. Output probabilities: float32 [batch,3]. Six actual inferences on synthetic constant RGB inputs returned finite normalized vectors. Repeated identical tensors produced identical probabilities.

scripts/verify-disturbing-model-candidate.mjs verifies exact runtime version, model hash/size, input/output names and output probability validity before reporting measurements. Requires an explicit isolated runtime directory and candidate file.
Rejects malformed/non-finite/unnormalized vectors and keeps a low gore score uncertain when the sexual class dominates. The evaluation thresholds are provisional, not a deployed policy.

verification.command: Coverage validator and git diff --check for new probe scripts

observed_host_measurements.environment: Windows host, bundled Node process, WASM single-thread CPU; not a browser/device benchmark
observed_host_measurements.limits: RSS includes the Node process and runtime, is not peak or model-only memory. Uniform tensors do not establish classification accuracy, image preprocessing parity or real browser performance.

next_required_work: Integrate an exact-version ONNX Runtime Web dependency without unrelated lockfile changes; self-host/hash-check model and matching WASM/loader assets, retain licenses and validate packaging/CSP.

Implement and verify the ONNX-specific bilinear RGB resize/NCHW preprocessing against the reference. Do not blindly reuse NSFWJS alignCorners normalization; normalization and softmax are already embedded in this ONNX graph.
Integrate independent disturbing verdicts into worker protocol, privacy policy and UI, preserving unknown on failures and mixed/uncertain content.
Representative NSFL evaluation, threshold calibration, adversarial input tests, real browser/Windows memory/performance and two-client acceptance before declaring the feature complete.
acceptance: Not accepted. Candidate compatibility is demonstrated, but the app still reports disturbing-content analysis as unknown. No application dependency, bundled model, production release or deployment was changed.
